components.name: Prismatic Observatory
components.description: Reusable nested orbital instrument: nine gyroscopic rings, satellites, a crystal heart and a star field. Controls for motion, expansion, inclination and palette.

components.name: Particle Tornado
components.description: Blue particles and amber sparks with adjustable count, height, width, spin, turbulence, size and glow.

components.name: Metallic Cube
components.description: Reusable spinning metallic cube. Includes a shared cube primitive module with the fan's six-color metallic palette.

components.name: Metallic Cube Fan
components.description: The complete six-arm, 168-cube metallic cascade as a reusable image-source component. Uses the shared cube primitive, with spin, spread, cascade speed and size controls.

components.name: Prismatic Cube Fan
components.description: Reusable metallic cube spiral with 1–20 rainbow arms, palette shift, reversible lightness gradient and cube size taper. Preserves the original Metallic Cube Fan separately.
